data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'man' (protector, defender) and 'tun' (tool). This name is often given to babies born into families that value protection and defense. The name Mantun carries the meaning “Protector, Defender” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mantun usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
